title: Convolution and Reservoir Sampling
description: Two small numeric utilities. Trace them by hand, derive output shapes and find boundary mistakes.

phases.title: Bug Fix
phases.prompt: Without running anything: give the length of f(x, w) as a formula in n = len(x), k = len(w), compute f([1,2,3,4,5],[1,0,-1]) by hand, then find the boundary bugs in convolve.js and sampling.js.

phases.title: Implement
phases.prompt: Add a `mode` option to convolve: 'valid' (current behaviour), 'same' (output length n, zero padded) and 'full' (n + k - 1). Explain how the kernel is flipped (or not) and what that means for convolution vs correlation.

phases.title: Optimize
phases.prompt: movingAverage in stats.js recomputes every window from scratch. State its complexity, then make it O(n). Also state the time and space complexity of reservoirSample and argue why it is uniform.
